opening.argument: The speaker opens by saying he will explain different ways to earn from gaming, then expressly says he is not providing an app but explaining methods. The discussion covers monetizing gaming content through streaming, donations, advertising, sponsorships, and gameplay or tutorial uploads; the description also presents the channel’s content as educational. The statement that Twitch is a platform where people can earn a lot is broad, but it is not a guaranteed return. Nothing in the cited material establishes a fee, a payment outcome, or deceptive conduct by a particular service. Taken together, these are general explanations of gaming monetization, not a concrete earning offer.
